attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Nevada Commerce Tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, and revenue threshold.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in Nevada; has_physical_presence == true AND below threshold
Has physical presence and exceeds threshold; has_physical_presence == true AND exceeds threshold
Has economic nexus and exceeds threshold; has_economic_nexus == true AND exceeds threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold ge and

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below threshold - no Commerce Tax due
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical presence but below threshold - no Commerce Tax due result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption true xdef result.nv_commerce_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_tax 0.0 xdef

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus - Commerce Tax filing required result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption false xdef

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required
action_details.action_postfix: // Economic nexus - Commerce Tax filing required result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption false xdef
// No nexus - no filing required result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption true xdef result.nv_commerce_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_refund_or_owed result.state_payments xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Nevada has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

initial_action.action_postfix: // Nevada has NO corporate income tax result.state_tax_rate 0.0 xdef result.state_additions 0.0 xdef result.state_subtractions 0.0 xdef
initial_action.action_comment: Initialize Nevada income adjustments (none - no income tax)

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with Nevada; has_economic_nexus == true OR has_physical_presence == true

action_details.action_comment: Nevada has NO corporate income tax
action_details.action_postfix: // Nevada has NO corporate income tax result.state_tax_rate 0.0 xdef result.state_additions 0.0 xdef result.state_subtractions 0.0 xdef
// No nexus - confirm zero tax result.state_tax_rate 0.0 xdef result.state_additions 0.0 xdef result.state_subtractions 0.0 xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine Nevada business classification for Commerce Tax rate. Sets appropriate Commerce Tax rate based on industry (NAICS code).

initial_action.action_postfix: // Default to Other Services rate result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_other_rate xdef

action_details.action_postfix: // Financial Services: 0.331% (highest rate) result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_financial_services_rate xdef
// Mining: 0.262% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_mining_rate xdef
// Utilities: 0.266% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_utilities_rate xdef
// Professional Services: 0.128% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_professional_services_rate xdef
// Retail Trade: 0.091% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_retail_trade_rate xdef
// Manufacturing: 0.091% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_manufacturing_rate xdef
// Wholesale Trade: 0.101% result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_wholesale_trade_rate xdef
// Other Services: 0.051% (lowest rate) result.nv_commerce_tax_rate result.nv_other_rate xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Nevada-sitused gross revenue for Commerce Tax. Uses market-based sourcing to determine revenue attributable to Nevada.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and has apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: has_nexus { pop apportionment_percentage 0 f> } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus but no apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: has_nexus { pop apportionment_percentage 0 f== } over if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Nevada-sitused revenue using market-based sourcing
action_details.action_postfix: // Calculate Nevada-sitused gross revenue using market-based sourcing result.total_revenue result.apportionment_percentage mul /result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef

action_details.action_comment: No apportionment - assume 100% Nevada if nexus exists
No Nevada nexus - no revenue sitused to Nevada

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Nevada Commerce Tax liability. Applies Commerce Tax rate to Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M. IMPORTANT: This is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and exceeds $4M threshold; has_nexus AND gross_revenue >= threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold ge and

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus but below threshold; has_nexus AND gross_revenue < threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold lt and

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Commerce Tax on taxable revenue

action_details.action_postfix: // Below threshold - no Commerce Tax result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption true xdef result.nv_taxable_revenue 0.0 xdef result.nv_commerce_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_refund_or_owed result.state_payments xdef

// No nexus - no Commerce Tax result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption true xdef result.nv_taxable_revenue 0.0 xdef result.nv_commerce_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_tax 0.0 xdef result.state_refund_or_owed result.state_payments xdef
